task_definition.task_description: Please look up headphones in electronics, check similar options for the Sony WH-1000XM5, choose one alternative for 1 unit, put it on hold, confirm the order, and then add that item to my cart. After that, scan my living room devices, pick the smart lock and lock it with PIN 2026, then check the living room light status and set its brightness to 35. Finally, get the details for Hilton Tokyo, prepare a deluxe hotel stay request for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-03, and then book flight AA100 for Jordan Lee in economy, making sure the booking status is checked.
